# QUARANTINED - Not Live

This directory (`src/kalshi_bot/`) contains an **abandoned rewrite** of the trading bot ("kalshi-botv3").

- It is **not imported or loaded** by any production code.
- It has **no business logic** - only an empty FastAPI/SQLAlchemy scaffold.
- The live bot is the **top-level flat `.py` files** in the repo root.

**Do not edit this directory unless you are intentionally reviving the rewrite.**
**Do not "fix" inconsistencies between this code and the live bot - they are intentional.**

See [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](../ARCHITECTURE.md) for the authoritative layout.
